INSERT INTO rust_sessions (id_digest, user_id, auth_salt, data, expires_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
         ON CONFLICT (id_digest) DO UPDATE SET
            user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id,
            auth_salt = EXCLUDED.auth_salt,
            data = EXCLUDED.data,
            expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
            updated_at = now()
